speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). The clinical presentation of severe pruritus and fatigue, combined with an isolated elevation in Alkaline Phosphatase (460 U/L) with only mildly elevated transaminases (AST/ALT < 100 U/L), is highly characteristic of this autoimmune cholestatic liver disease. I request images of your skin to look for xanthomas or excoriations, which can further support this diagnosis.
